state.task:
Question-answering task using the company document service.

The company handbook is held by a document service; it is not available as files. Documents
have a header line (version, status, effective dates, what they supersede) and numbered
sections; each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded
versions, and memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the
situation and date in the question.

Service actions (reply with one of these instead of "execute"):
  {"action": "search", "query": "lodging limit Geneva", "k": 5, "thought": "..."}
      up to k (at most 8; default 5) ranked passages with ids and document headers. Each
      result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (path in the result header),
      where your code can read it later.
  {"action": "fetch", "ids": ["HB-07 §2", "HB-12"], "thought": "..."}
      the named passages in full; a document id ("HB-12") returns all its sections; at most
      10 ids per fetch.
You can still use "execute" for code (for example to read saved results or manage your
context), and "final" to answer.

Questions:
- Q1: What is the mileage rate for a business trip in a private electric car today? (answer in cents per km)
- Q2: What is the daily meal allowance for a standard travel day with an approved client dinner today? (answer in EUR per day)
- Q3: What is the childcare subsidy for a single parent with one child under six working 16 hours a week today? (answer in EUR per month)
- Q4: What is the annual training budget for a regular employee today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR per year)
- Q5: What flight fare limit applied to a standard return flight within Europe on 2026-02-15? (answer in EUR per return flight)
- Q6: What is the home-office equipment allowance for an employee with a medical accessibility plan who works 16 hours a week today? (answer in EUR)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the rule
and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.step_intent: Find the home-office equipment allowance that applies to: What is the home-office equipment allowance for an employee with a medical accessibility plan who works 16 hours a week today?

passages.source: HB-42 §1 | Remote work: home-office equipment — Scope | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-05-01 · supersedes: HB-64
passages.text: This policy sets the home-office equipment allowance for all employees. Claims for the home-office equipment allowance are filed in the expense tool under 'Remote work: home-office equipment'. The facilities publishes worked examples of the home-office equipment allowance on the intranet.

passages.source: HB-42 §2 | Remote work: home-office equipment — Standard home-office equipment allowance | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-05-01 · supersedes: HB-64
passages.text: Employees may claim a one-off home-office equipment allowance of 350 EUR. Questions about the home-office equipment allowance go to the facilities, who keeps the record of decisions. Each claim for the home-office equipment allowance needs a receipt showing the date, the amount and the supplier.

passages.source: HB-64 §2 | Remote work: home-office equipment — Standard home-office equipment allowance | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-05-01 to the day before 2026-05-01 · superseded by: HB-42
passages.text: Employees may claim a one-off home-office equipment allowance of 300 EUR. The facilities reviews the home-office equipment allowance once a year and announces changes in advance. Managers confirm claims for the home-office equipment allowance before payment in the next payroll run.

passages.source: HB-42 §4 | Remote work: home-office equipment — Exceptions | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-05-01 · supersedes: HB-64
passages.text: Group exceptions to the home-office equipment allowance are published in HB-03. Questions about the home-office equipment allowance go to the facilities, who keeps the record of decisions. The facilities publishes worked examples of the home-office equipment allowance on the intranet.
